title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor for Rated Voltages up to and including 450/750 V
scope: Covers requirements and tests for PVC insulated single-core and multi-core cables for electric power and lighting in domestic and commercial buildings up to and including 450/750 V.
source: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Official Catalogue - Electrotechnical Department ETD 09

evidence_sample.text: For cables installed in wet or damp indoor locations, PVC type ST1 or ST2 outer sheaths complying with moisture absorption and water resistance tests shall be specified to prevent insulation breakdown.

compliance.mandated_by: Electrical Wires and Cables (Quality Control) Order
compliance.details: Mandatory compliance under BIS Certification Scheme I, Schedule II for commercial sale and government procurement.

Methods of Test for Cables - Part 53: Flammability Test

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: Covers requirements and tests for single core, two core, three core, four core and multi-core PVC insulated and PVC sheathed armored and unarmored electric cables for electricity supply in heavy duty commercial and industrial installations.
source: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) - ETD 09 Cables and Wires

evidence_sample.text: Armoured heavy-duty cables laid in underground building ducts, basements, or water-prone areas must feature extruded PVC outer sheathing capable of resisting subterranean water ingress and mechanical abrasion.

compliance.mandated_by: Quality Control Order (QCO) for Low Voltage Cables
compliance.details: Conformity to IS 1554 (Part 1) is mandatory under Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) notification.

title: Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures (IP Code)
scope: Applies to the classification of degrees of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment with a rated voltage not exceeding 72.5 kV against ingress of solid foreign objects and water.
source: BIS Harmonized IEC Standard - Electrotechnical Department

evidence_sample.section: Clause 14: Tests for Protection Against Water (Second Characteristic Numeral)
evidence_sample.text: Numeral 7 specifies protection against effects of temporary immersion in water up to 1 m depth. Numeral 8 specifies protection against continuous submersion in water under agreed conditions.

compliance.mandated_by: Referenced by CPWD & GeM specifications for outdoor/wet electrical installations
compliance.details: Required to certify IP65/IP67/IP68 waterproof ratings for cable glands, junction boxes, and submersible terminations.

test_methods.title: Immersion Tank Test for IPX7 and Continuous Pressure Water Test for IPX8

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scope: Applies to the design, selection, erection, inspection and testing of electrical installations in residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.
source: BIS National Building Code (NBC) Electrotechnical Division

evidence_sample.section: Section 522.3: Presence of Water or High Humidity
evidence_sample.text: Wiring systems shall be selected and erected so that no damage is caused by the ingress of water. Cables in damp situations or outside buildings shall be installed in watertight conduit systems or shall possess moisture-resistant sheathing complying with IS 1554 or IS 694.

compliance.details: Mandatory for building safety approval under Central Electricity Authority Regulations, 2010.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: Specifies requirements for single, twin, three and multi-core XLPE insulated cables for electricity supply up to 1.1 kV with higher thermal and moisture endurance.

evidence_sample.text: XLPE insulation provides superior moisture and thermal resistance (up to 90°C continuous conductor temperature) compared to PVC, recommended for wet conduit environments and flooded cable trenches.

compliance.details: Mandatory under DPIIT Electrical Wires and Cables Order.
